articles.title: Health & Medicine 健康与医学
articles.summary: Vaccination, chronic disease research and public health policy.

sentences.orig: Public health officials have launched a nationwide vaccination campaign aimed at curbing the spread of infectious diseases.
sentences.trans: 公共卫生官员发起了全国性疫苗接种运动，旨在遏制传染病的传播。

sentences.orig: Researchers have identified a potential breakthrough in the treatment of chronic diseases, offering hope to millions of patients.
sentences.trans: 研究人员在慢性病治疗方面发现了潜在突破，为数百万患者带来希望。

sentences.orig: Mental health awareness has gained significant traction, with schools and workplaces introducing support programmes.
sentences.trans: 心理健康意识获得显著关注，学校和工作场所纷纷引入支持计划。

sentences.orig: The healthcare system faces mounting pressure from an ageing population and rising medical costs.
sentences.trans: 医疗体系面临人口老龄化和医疗成本上升带来的日益增长的压力。

sentences.orig: Clinical trials have demonstrated that the new drug significantly reduces recovery time with minimal side effects.
sentences.trans: 临床试验表明，新药能显著缩短恢复时间，且副作用极小。

sentences.orig: Preventive medicine, including regular screenings and healthy lifestyles, is increasingly recognised as the cornerstone of public health.
sentences.trans: 包括定期筛查和健康生活方式在内的预防医学，日益被视为公共卫生的基石。

sentences.orig: Health experts caution that the overuse of antibiotics has accelerated the emergence of drug-resistant bacteria.
sentences.trans: 健康专家警告，抗生素的过度使用加速了耐药细菌的出现。

sentences.orig: The pandemic has underscored the critical importance of global cooperation in addressing health emergencies.
sentences.trans: 疫情凸显了全球合作应对突发卫生事件的关键重要性。
